semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company acts as an agent for various semiconductor-related components and equipment, but does not appear to manufacture or provide core semiconductor technologies.
summary: Wuxi Shanghaibest Imp.& Exp. Co., Ltd. is an international trading company specializing in the import and export of semiconductor-related products, including various types of lamps and mini motors. They also offer diffusion furnace equipment and monitoring software as an agent for Qingdao HIDICON.
capabilities: Distribution of Japanese USHIO lamps including UV and halogen types
Distribution of German Faulhaber and Swiss Escap mini motors
Supply of high-performance thermocouples from NANMAC and Prime
Agent for diffusion furnace equipment and monitoring software

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and is approved by the Ministry of Commerce for international trading activities.
